item.title: Nirmal Purja performed momentous feats in the Death Zone
item.description:
"Listen to the gripping story of Nirmal Purja, a mountaineer who achieved unprecedented success in the Himalayas, conquering the highest peaks in the 'Death Zone' and redefining human limits. Tune in to our podcast for an inspiring tale of adventure and perseverance." (155 characters, 30 words)
Alternatively, a more concise version: "Discover Nirmal Purja's record-breaking climbs in the 'Death Zone', a testament to human resilience and determination, on our latest podcast episode." (137 characters, 24 words)
